pages.text: A pot bubbled in the kitchen. Its lid rattled and rattled.
Rudi wondered what was inside and stood on tiptoe.
Grandma turned away to fetch bowls. Steam rose from the pot.
Rudi reached out. Their fingertips touched the lid.
Ouch, hot! Rudi pulled the hand back quickly.
Their fingertips turned red. Tears welled up.
Rudi hid the hand behind their back. They still hadn't seen inside the pot.
Grandma Bear put Rudi's hand in cold water. "For hot things, ask for a grown-up's hand."
Grandma lifted the lid. Steam billowed up.
Rudi looked into the pot. Yellow soup bubbled away.
